text: Gale pinned commit 98508f8 passes 8 JVM + 8 JS artifact interop tests. zarr4s pinned b7c9840 exposed two deliberate pre-1.0 error-ADT migrations: InvalidShape -> ShapeError and NonContiguousLayout -> CanonicalLayoutError.
